text:
Type: jacquard curtain panels, set of two
Use: dressing a window, filtering light; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: cotton sateen, woven floral jacquard, rod pocket top
Colors: warm taupe, cream pattern
Shape: long straight panel, gathered rod pocket header, soft vertical folds, tone-on-tone floral damask pattern, subtle sheen, floor length
Feel: soft, elegant, warm
Goes with: cream or beige walls, dark wood, brass or bronze rods; traditional or classic rooms

product.name: Pinzon Fleur Jacquard Egyptian Cotton Sateen Window Drape, Set of 2, Taupe/Cream
product.description: Set of 2 window drapes with a jacquard floral pattern; 2 tie-backs included; made in Portugal Made of 100-percent Egyptian cotton in a 300-thread-count sateen weave; matching valance sold separately 4 standard rod pockets along top; bottom corners mitered and weighted for elegant look and proper hang Machine wash cool and tumble dry low; coordinates with Pinzon Fleur Jacquard collection Each panel measures 50 by 84 inches
